title: E3 범위를 넘는 barrier·GPU 완료 대기 중복 축소
existingWork: 동일 compute 패스의 발행 완료 범위 재사용(E3)은 이미 구현·실험. 그 밖의 render stage/submit/query/fence 경계가 조사 범위.
missingEvidence: worker idle wait는 제거 가능한 GPU wait 증거가 아님. 정확한 critical-path blocked time과 중복 증명이 없음.
requiredBoundary: 실제 의존성·query 가용성·완료/실패·주소 재사용 계약을 유지.

risk.function: 매우높음: query availability·host read·opaque counter/외부wait·실패처리 의미.
risk.lifetime: 매우높음: GPU완료 이전 resource/address/allocator 재사용 방지.
risk.memory: 불필요 fullwait 축소가 memory lifetime을 줄일 수도 있지만 성급한완료는UAF, 느슨한defer는retention확대.

strategy: Choose one observed redundant edge outside the completed experimental E3/Combined candidate; E3 is not active in frozen R unless explicitly composed. Preserve actual issued RAW/WAR/WAW visibility, destination stages, query availability, host reads, semantic signals, error cleanup and address/allocator reuse. A worker idle wait alone never proves a removable GPU wait.
acceptance: Name the exact edge, producer/consumer and critical-path wait interval
Prove alternative ordered visibility for every affected consumer and terminal failure path
Independent ownership/synchronization design review passes before any wait/barrier change
tests: Cross-queue/host/query/address-reuse and poison/cancel cases; no global wait suppression
dependencyMeaning: Interactions require re-review; they are not permission to enable all related changes together.
designStage: Exact source capsules where named; broader missing-target/ownership/pass designs remain gated where stated
stopRule: Any unclosed correctness/lifetime counterexample, changed parent, failed check or unclear measurement stops this module. Preserve failure evidence; no automatic replay.
rollback: Prepared source module: exact reverse patch only against its postimage, refresh mtimes and rebuild all affected headers. No-code module: active product remains unchanged; no invented reverse patch.
